jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern, Frontend
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Explore our Engineering Blog & Emerging Talent Blog to learn more about how we build at Ramp and what it’s like to start your career here.

About the Role

Ramp is, at its core, an engineering company. We’re looking for frontend and full-stack engineering interns who are excited to build intuitive, high-quality products that solve complex problems for our customers.

Our ideal candidate has strong JavaScript fundamentals, an eye for great user experiences, and enjoys turning customer needs into thoughtful engineering solutions. Our frontend stack includes TypeScript, React, Vite, and Ryu, our in-house design system.

What You’ll Do

  • Build performant, beautiful, and intuitive interfaces for businesses with complex needs

  • Own meaningful projects and ship products alongside cross-functional teams

  • Work closely with product, design, and business teams to turn customer feedback into product improvements

  • Contribute to the tools, systems, and engineering practices that help Ramp scale

What You’ll Need

  • Currently pursuing a B.S. or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field, graduating December 2027 or later

  • Strong JavaScript fundamentals and attention to visual and product details

  • Experience with one or more programming languages

  • Track record of shipping high-quality products, features, or side projects

  • Ability to turn product and business ideas into engineering solutions

  • Desire to learn quickly, take ownership, and work in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with React

  • Familiarity with or interest in TypeScript and modern frontend development

  • Interest in fintech, AI, or building products at scale

Compensation

The monthly rate for this internship is $12,500 + a housing stipend.

Ramp Benefits

  • Apple MacBook

  • Catered lunches and dinners in our NYC office Monday through Friday

  • $10/week for Coffee with a Colleague

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

 

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is scaling the Sales Development org, and we're hiring a Recruiter to help build it. SDR hiring is its own discipline: the bar is high, the volume is real, and the strongest candidates rarely have a track record long enough to read.

You'll work with our Sales Development recruiter, owning full-cycle SDR hiring: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and offer close. It's a foundational seat with real autonomy. You'll work as a team to build the playbook. The SD team you're hiring for moves fast, with consistent quota beats and frequent promotions.

What You'll Do

  • Own pipeline hygiene in Ashby, moving candidates through stages, keeping data clean, and flagging what's stuck.

  • Schedule and coordinate interviews across hiring managers, panelists, and candidates.

  • Run clear, timely candidate communication and a consistently good candidate experience, even at high volume.

  • Keep scorecards and business case materials up to date and consistently applied, so hiring managers test the same way every time.

  • Flag process friction early instead of waiting for someone else to catch it.

  • Use AI daily for drafting outreach, summarizing notes, and speeding up research.

  • Support sourcing and screening using LinkedIn Recruiter, AI tools like Claude, and internal data.

What You Need

  • 0 to 2 years in recruiting, sales, or a candidate/client-facing role. SDR/BDR experience is a strong plus.

  • A track record of overachieving against a goal or quota, in any context.

  • Genuinely good at multitasking, with many candidates and stakeholders in motion at once and nothing slipping.

  • High emotional intelligence: reads a room accurately, adapts on the fly, and knows when to push and when to hold back.

  • Trustworthy with sensitive comp and candidate information.

  • Highly organized, catching what's off before it becomes a problem.

  • Strong written communication.

  • Low ego, high curiosity, comfortable learning the craft rather than just executing a checklist.

  • Genuine interest in using AI as part of daily workflow.

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

We are looking for an Analyst, Deal Operations to help drive Ramp’s next phase of growth! Reporting to the Senior Manager, Deal Desk, you’ll be a key partner in taking our Sales organization to the next level, responsible for quoting, pricing structure, and contracting for our Sales team. You'll be an integral part of the Deal Operations team with a focus on offering guidance to drive deal execution while complying with company policies and procedures and ensuring consistency to manage risk. You’ll work directly with our Sales, Legal, Accounting, and cross-functional leadership to better streamline efficient workflows and enhance sales productivity.

What You'll Do

  • Quote & contract approvals — review and approve quotes and contract workflows within policy; escalate exceptions with clear context

  • Feature & subscription activation — enable product tiers, configure accounts, and manage trial extensions, and coordinate billing

  • Policy & process guidance — be the first line of support for AEs with questions about deal structure, approval requirements, and process

  • Playbook development — document what you learn; help build the SOPs and escalation guides that make this function scalable

  • Drive consistency across deal processes by helping to optimize, streamline, and automate quote-to-cash processes

  • Serves as a subject matter expert on deal constructs, operational procedures, approval policies, and controls

What You Need

  • 1+ years in a Deal Desk environment, preferably in a high growth SaaS company.

  • Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, and other sales-related systems, including pricing and data enrichment tools.

  • Exceptional communication skills, written and verbal.

  • Excellent project management instincts, with an ability to manage multiple projects at one time.

  • You have a “get things done” mentality; you can dissect problems, identify solutions, and drive these solutions to completion with a high degree of autonomy.

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Security, Stablecoin
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is, at its core, a fintech company. Our financial infrastructure enables us to issue cards, move money globally, and manage treasury flows for our customers. Stablecoins are emerging as a critical lever to make these flows faster, cheaper, and more accessible.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our engineering team with a dedicated focus on stablecoin-based payment and treasury systems. In this role, you will act as both a technical owner and multiplier: working on core stablecoin services, ensuring secure and reliable integrations with external partners, and guiding Ramp’s evolution toward next-generation fintech solutions.

Our ideal candidate combines deep curiosity about eventually consistent distributed systems with strong financial infrastructure experience, thrives in highly regulated and mission-critical environments, and has a passion for diving into new problem spaces.

What You'll Do

  • Help build & scale Ramp’s stablecoin-based payment and treasury infrastructure

  • Partner with external providers and internal stakeholders to deliver end-to-end product flows

  • Solve Ramp’s toughest fintech challenges with new technologies

  • Collaborate with engineers across Ramp to integrate stablecoin capabilities into core products

What You Need

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience shipping high-quality architectures for critical systems preferred

  • Proven experience with stablecoin technologies, blockchain-based payment rails, and/or wallet infrastructure

  • Strong production experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or equivalent)

  • Deep proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (Python, Go, Java, or similar)

  • Experience working on security-sensitive systems, with interest in key management, wallet security, or secure transaction flows.

  • Experience building or operating payments, money movement, treasury, stablecoin, or crypto infrastructure in production environments

Nice to Have

  • Intuition for on-chain UX and settlement mechanics, including wallet-based transaction signing, confirmation/finality, and chain-level tradeoffs like fees and latency.

  • Direct experience building on-chain wallets or with integrating a crypto onramp / offramp APIs for custody and remittance flows

  • Experience integrating with external financial service providers and APIs at scale

  • Familiarity with cross-border settlement, FX, or treasury management systems

  • Background in highly regulated fintech environments (e.g., payments, banking, or government-compliant infrastructure)

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

About the Role

Ramp is launching payments across the EU through its Swedish payment institution. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards European businesses and keeps them trading, across Ramp's own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We're a small team that runs on frontier AI tooling: our operators build and use their own automations so they can spend their time on judgement, not admin. We're hiring a KYB/AML Analyst in Stockholm to review and onboard business customers of our Swedish entity, work directly with those customers to get them live, and resolve onboarding requirements raised by our partners. You'll join a small Swedish team and help keep onboarding moving every day as we grow.

What You'll Do

  • Carry out first-line (1LoD) KYB reviews of business customers onboarding with Ramp's Swedish payment institution: company verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and risk assessment

  • Decide standard cases end to end, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases with a clear rationale

  • Handle customer communications through onboarding: clear document requests, follow-ups and status updates

  • Resolve onboarding requirements from our card-issuing and payments partners for EU customers

  • Document decisions to a standard that holds up to second-line and regulatory review

  • Keep Swedish casework moving when teammates are on leave or handling incidents

  • Spend part of your time improving how we work: playbooks, templates and AI-assisted workflows

What You Need

  • 2–4 years of KYB / AML / onboarding experience at a fintech, payment institution, EMI or bank

  • Solid grounding in business customer due diligence: company registers, UBO identification, sanctions/PEP screening, and spotting red flags

  • Fluent English, written and verbal

  • Clear, friendly written communication with customers

  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make casework faster and better

  • Based in, or relocating to, Stockholm, with the right to work in Sweden

Nice-to-Haves

  • Swedish (strongly preferred)

  • Familiarity with Swedish sources and requirements (Bolagsverket, the beneficial ownership register, FI expectations under the Swedish AML Act)

  • Experience onboarding EU businesses across several jurisdictions

  • An additional European language

About the Role

Ramp's Strategic Finance team sits at the center of how the company allocates its time and resources. We're hiring across three complementary tracks — and looking for people with sharp financial instincts, a builder's mindset, and the drive to take on a large scope quickly. Whether you lean toward GTM strategy, FP&A infrastructure, or broad strategic partnership, this is a rare opportunity to shape a pre-IPO company at a pivotal moment in its growth.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own detailed financial and operational models with the highest quality and accuracy

  • Use data to influence key strategic decisions across Product, GTM, and business leadership

  • Lead planning analyses for cross-functional teams, evaluating tradeoffs across growth, efficiency, and resourcing

  • Identify and develop KPIs; build dashboards to monitor performance and communicate insights to stakeholders

  • Partner closely with business leaders to translate strategy into execution and drive accountability

  • Help run bi-annual budgeting and headcount planning cycles

  • Manage company performance against financial targets — identifying where to course-correct and where to accelerate

  • Build and maintain internal tools that reduce manual work and improve data accuracy across the finance org

 

What You Need

  • 4+ years in Investment Banking, Management Consulting, VC/PE, or Corporate Finance at a top-tier technology company

  • Excellent financial modeling and quantitative / data analysis skills

  • Extreme attention to detail with a high regard for precision

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

  • Track record of developing and maintaining relationships with internal and external partners

  • A "get things done" mentality — you dissect complex problems, find solutions, and drive them to completion with a high degree of autonomy

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and adapting to evolving priorities
